data.name: Psycho Path
data.detailed_description:
Psycho Path is a cooperative online platformer where players use psychic powers, teamwork, and precision to climb their way to the top of ever-changing worlds. Manage your psychic energy, combine abilities, and use your friends as platforms to reach new heights.

In Psycho Path, every climb is a test of control and coordination. Up to six players connect online to scale a procedurally generated vertical world filled with moving platforms, shifting hazards, and unpredictable structures.

Your psychic powers let you grab, push, and lift objects or teammates, but each action consumes energy. Managing your psychic power bar is essential to keep the team moving upward. Poor coordination can leave everyone stranded far below.

With ragdoll physics, proximity voice chat, and multiple biomes, no two climbs are ever the same. Communication and timing determine whether the team reaches the top or collapses on the way up.

Key Features

  • Online Co-op for up to 6 Players – Work together to climb through challenging procedural environments.

  • Psychic Power Management – Every use of power drains energy. Spend it carefully to keep your team progressing.

  • Procedurally Generated Maps – Each session offers a new layout and biome to explore.

  • Proximity Voice Chat – Coordinate with teammates or react to the chaos around you in real time.

  • Ragdoll Physics – Natural and unpredictable physics make every movement unique.

  • Cosmetics and Collectibles – Unlock outfits and accessories to customize your climber.

  • Dynamic Teamplay – Use teammates as platforms, tools, or lifelines to reach the summit together.

Climb Together or Fall Alone

Every climb in Psycho Path is a shared challenge that demands patience, timing, and cooperation. Master your psychic abilities, adapt to the environment, and support your team to reach the peak.

It is not about speed. It is about control, teamwork, and using every resource you have to overcome the impossible climb.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4000 series or equivalent
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 750TI or equivalent, integrated graphics not supported
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: A PC, a microphone and a voice tchat software (Discord or equivalent)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4000 series or equivalent
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 970 or equivalent, integrated graphics not supported
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: A PC, a microphone and a voice tchat software (Discord or equivalent)
